name: Resomix Design System
summary: V2 'brutal' kept as the look, resolved to WCAG 2.2 AA: opaque text colours, a danger colour you can tell from the accent, warning and info, 11px minimum text, a fixed type, space, size and shape scale, and every component state defined.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Neon orange from the brand guidelines. Source of accent; logo and marketing art only.

tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: Space black from the brand guidelines. Logo ground only; the product canvas is darker.

tokens.name: brand-gray
tokens.usage: Light gray from the brand guidelines. Logo and marketing art only.

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: White from the brand guidelines. Logo ink.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The page behind everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, rows. The default ground for content.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: A surface on a surface: inset rows, the alternate result row, a badge ground.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs and the results header band. Darker than the panel it sits in.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Rows, secondary buttons and pressable panels under the pointer. Opaque, so text on it is checked.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: A secondary control or row while pressed.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, toasts, drawers. Always with border-strong and shadow-overlay.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: A selected card or row. Always with the accent border or marker, never alone.

tokens.name: playing
tokens.usage: The playing row and the playing play-button.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: The ground of accent badges (Active task, Selected).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: The ground of an error toast, inline error and destructive dialog header.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and the phone drawer. Never a ground for text.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles, track names, values, button labels.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy, descriptions, artists.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, table headers, hints, timestamps. Darker than V2 so it reads as a third step, still 6:1 or more.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled and busy labels (Searching…). Kept at 4.5:1 so a busy label stays readable.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Small orange text: the Selected tag, rank 1, // separators, Reference selected.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: text-danger
tokens.usage: Error messages and the destructive button label. Pinker than the accent so the two never read as one colour.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative: lines between rows, lines inside a panel.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Decorative: panel edges. Never the only edge of something people operate.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes, unselected cards you can press. 3:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover edge of controls; overlay edges; the paused row marker.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fills, bars, marks and markers: the primary action, selected, playing, the panel mark. Never body text.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: The accent fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: The accent fill while pressed.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring, always with the canvas-coloured gap (ring).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved, connected, kept. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Limits close to running out, a preview missing, a maybe. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: edges, icons, the danger button. V2's #ff7660 was 1 hue step from the accent.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices: nothing changed, why a control is blocked.

tokens.name: match-track
tokens.usage: The empty part of a match bar.

tokens.name: match-from
tokens.usage: Start of the match bar fill. The gradient runs to accent.

tokens.name: match-tick
tokens.usage: The end tick of a match bar; 3:1 against the fill.

tokens.name: score-neutral
tokens.usage: A neutral score bar (not a match).

type.rule: Two voices. Helvetica is what people read; Fira Code uppercase is the machine readout (labels, buttons, headers, numbers). Benzin is the brand, marketing only. Nothing under 11px.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing hero headline. Once per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Marketing section opener, the closing call to action.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Page title in the app (FIND SIMILAR TRACKS). Light weight, uppercase, 5 words or fewer.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A heading inside content, dialog titles.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Task cards and pressable panels (ANALYSE A TRACK). 4 words or fewer.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The one sentence under a page or section title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Paragraphs, descriptions, messages. V2 set these at 300; 400 below 18px keeps thin strokes readable on black.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Help text, artist under a title, toast body.

styles.name: track-title
styles.usage: Track titles in result rows (NIGHT SIGNAL).

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Section kicker after an accent rule (— SIMILAR TRACKS FOR THIS REFERENCE).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels, 3 words or fewer. Written in sentence case in the markup; CSS sets the caps, so screen readers read words, not letters.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, badges, sub-labels, OUTPUT // lines.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Table headers and dense meta. The floor: V2's 9px headers move here.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers people compare: BPM, key, time, score. Tabular figures.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Numbers under a bar (9.30), label and year in rows.

space.unit: --px-N (N/16 rem, scales with the root size as in V2)

steps.name: space-0-5
steps.usage: Badge inner block padding, hairline offsets.

steps.name: space-1
steps.usage: Icon to label in small controls.

steps.name: space-2
steps.usage: Icon to text in buttons; between related controls.

steps.name: space-3
steps.usage: Row cell gaps; badge inline padding.

steps.name: space-6
steps.usage: Panel padding on phones; between a panel and its caption.

steps.name: space-8
steps.usage: Panel padding on desktop; between panels.

shape.name: radius-panel
shape.usage: Panels, cards, tables, dialogs, toasts. Square, always.

shape.name: radius-control
shape.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges, checkboxes, the play button.

shape.name: radius-round
shape.usage: Radios and status dots. Nothing else is round; switches are square like everything else.

shape.name: notch-sm
shape.usage: The cut top-right corner of the primary button (36px and under).

shape.name: notch-md
shape.usage: The cut corner of the 44px primary button and a selected card.

shape.name: notch-lg
shape.usage: The cut corner of marketing tiles and the hero call to action at 48px+.

shape.name: mark-length
shape.usage: Length of the accent mark on a panel's top edge, inset space-6 from the left.

shape.name: mark-thin
shape.usage: Mark on a panel that presents information.

shape.name: mark-thick
shape.usage: Mark on a panel you can press.

shape.name: marker
shape.usage: Inset left marker on a row: accent = playing or selected, border-strong = paused, danger = failed.

shape.name: rule-length
shape.usage: The accent rule before a kicker.

shape.name: border-width
shape.usage: Every border. Selected cards and the focus gap also use 1px.

elevation.name: shadow-none
elevation.usage: Everything on the page. Depth comes from the ground steps and hairlines.

elevation.name: shadow-overlay
elevation.usage: Dialogs, menus, toasts, drawers, with border-strong.

elevation.name: ring
elevation.usage: Focus: a 1px canvas gap then a 2px focus ring. Works on accent fills too.

size.name: control-sm
size.usage: Row actions, badges with an action, compact page buttons.

size.name: control-md
size.usage: Page buttons and fields (Profile, Library, plans).

size.name: control-lg
size.usage: Workspace buttons and fields; every main control on a phone.

size.name: icon-lg
size.usage: Play/pause, empty states, task card icons.

size.name: content-max
size.usage: Widest content (78rem at the design size).

motion.source: The motion scale from transitions.dev (github.com/Jakubantalik/transitions.dev, skills/transitions-dev/_root.css), kept under its own names so every transitions.dev snippet works unchanged. Match a value by usage, not by number.

durations.name: duration-micro
durations.usage: Tooltip and path delay, one shake segment, large stagger.

durations.name: duration-quick
durations.usage: Colour and border changes on hover and press, modal and dropdown close, text swap, tooltip appear.

durations.name: duration-fast
durations.usage: Icon swap, dropdown and modal open, tabs sliding, page slide, toast close.

durations.name: duration-medium
durations.usage: Toggle travel, toast open, panel close, checkmark draw, learn-more chevron.

durations.name: duration-slow
durations.usage: Panel open, skeleton content reveal, input clear.

durations.name: duration-very-slow
durations.usage: Emphasis moments, badge appear, text reveal, success check.

easings.name: ease-smooth-out
easings.usage: Default: hover and press colour, modal, dropdown, panel and toast open and close, page slide, resize, position change, shake segments.

easings.name: ease-in-out
easings.usage: Icon swap, text swap, text reveal, skeleton pulse and reveal.

easings.name: ease-out
easings.usage: Tooltip open and close, input border colour.

distances.name: distance-base
distances.usage: Badge reveal, page slide, error shake (large segment).

scales.name: scale-large
scales.usage: Modal and dialog open and close.

blur.name: blur-small
blur.usage: Panel reveal, icon swap, text swap, toast, skeleton reveal.
